name: shadi-planner-matrimony
description: Full-Stack Matrimonial & Wedding Planning Web Application built with React TypeScript & Node.js TypeScript

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){fs.cpSync('client/dist','dist',{recursive:true});}"
